title: The 3 A.M. Call Could See Me #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine your phone rings at 3 a.m. Unknown number.
A child's voice whispers, "I can see your light."
You laugh. Wrong number. You hang up.
You run to the window and pull the curtain shut.
It's you. At the window. Taken one second ago.
Would you turn around, or call the number back? Comment A or B.
